checkpoint_plan.stop_rule: Stop after the first 8 windows if >1 window fails the valid-fraction gate; report the failure instead of filling.

checkpoint_plan.gate: >=27/30 windows computed; valid_fraction >= 0.8; all rejected items recorded with reason; no zero-fill.
checkpoint_plan.objective: Moon Kaguya TC v2 windows across three regions.
checkpoint_plan.sampling: 10 items per region; filter gsd <= 30 m, proj:shape >= [200, 200] px, and footprint fully containing the 2.2 km read bbox.
checkpoint_plan.stop_rule: Stop after 10 items if >3 items fail QA or coverage; report the region as sparse, not global.

checkpoint_plan.gate: >=27/30 windows computed; valid_fraction >= 0.8; no Jezero bbox request; every rejected item recorded.

checkpoint_plan.sampling: 10 items per region (Gale and two other bboxes with >= 20 matching items); filter gsd <= 36 m and footprint fully containing the 2.2 km read bbox.

gap_summary.finding: No verified global Mars DEM at or finer than 90 m exists in the sources checked. Best global products are HRSC-MOLA 200 m (CC BY-SA, 2.22x coarser) and MOLA 463 m (5.15x coarser).
gap_summary.implication: Mars D01 metrics remain limited to sparse 20-36 m CTX DTMs, sparse HiRISE DTMs, and the five existing Jezero windows. No global Mars 90 m claim is possible.

gap_summary.finding: SLDEM2015 512 ppd covers only 60S-60N. Poleward of 60 degrees the verified global grids are 118.45 m (LOLA 256 ppd / Moon Trek) or 236.9 m (LDEM128); the only fine polar product is the 5 m LOLA south-pole mosaic/site set.
gap_summary.implication: Moon north-polar and 60-87S windows cannot be produced at true 90 m from a global source. South-polar windows can use 5 m LOLA; elsewhere polar metrics are coarse/context or require new products.

gap_summary.finding: The fine sources are sparse footprints: 155,925 Kaguya DTMs, 44,628 CTX DTMs and 1,262 HiRISE DTMs. Item counts are not area coverage, and a 1.98 km square window is not guaranteed inside a footprint.
gap_summary.implication: Any expansion must be checkpointed and per-window coverage-checked; failed windows are missing, never zero-filled.

gap_summary.finding: SLDEM2015 is a LOLA + Kaguya TC fusion at 59.2 m. It is method-compatible with the 90 m contract but has not been co-located and compared with the 5 m LOLA site windows.
gap_summary.implication: Treat SLDEM-derived metrics as a separate source until a co-located sensitivity test quantifies the difference. Do not mix them silently with existing 5 m LOLA reference values.

gap_summary.finding: Kaguya TC v2 items vary from 10.33 m to 5,003 m GSD in sampled records; one sampled item was a 9 x 2,181 px strip.
gap_summary.implication: Filter on item gsd, proj:shape and footprint before planning a 1.98 km window. Reject items that cannot contain the window.

gap_summary.finding: 3 of 10 sampled HiRISE STAC items advertised a dtm href without the stereo-pair folder and returned HTTP 404; the corrected folder URL returned HTTP 206.
gap_summary.implication: The planner must repair or validate each href before reading. A 404 is recorded as a missing item, never zero-filled.

gap_summary.finding: The sampled Jezero bbox (18-18.7E, 18.3-18.7N) returned 0 CTX DTMs in the 44,628-item STAC collection. The existing five Jezero windows use a separate USGS Mars 2020 mosaic.
gap_summary.implication: Do not plan Jezero expansion from the CTX STAC collection. Reuse the existing mosaic only within its verified footprint.

gap_summary.finding: The USGS HRSC-MOLA 200 m blend is licensed as MOLA (CC0) + HRSC (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO).
gap_summary.implication: Derived products may carry share-alike obligations. Legal review is required before ingestion; MOLA 463 m (public domain) or CTX DTMs (CC0) are the safer coarse/fine alternatives.

gap_summary.finding: The PGDA LDEM128, six 5 m site DEMs and the 87-90S mosaic do not state a licence on their product pages.
gap_summary.implication: The existing repository relies on the NASA Science Data Portal CC0 general licence and citation. Confirm before redistributing new derived products; do not describe them as explicitly CC0.

gap_summary.finding: LOLA RDR/COPC is a point cloud, not a DEM; gridding changes slope, roughness and flat fraction.
gap_summary.implication: Do not compute D01 metrics directly from points. Use SLDEM2015, PGDA DEMs or a documented, validated gridding method.
